lines.text: Ahead of the last season, {leader} has the prize in sight and a rival still refusing to disappear.
lines.was: {leader} has reached the last season with the prize still requiring a proper answer.

lines.text: Down here, all the reasons for starting are about to acquire a rather sharper edge.
lines.was: Down here, every reason for starting this contest is about to come back into focus.

lines.text: For {trailer}, looking past the immediate task offers nothing. The opportunity is right in front.
lines.was: For {trailer}, there is no need to look beyond the next campaign. That is the opportunity.

lines.text: At {winnerClub}, any temptation to relax must compete with the knowledge that this remains undecided.
You would understand {leader} wanting the wait over, then wishing for a moment longer.
Soon the introduction and the farewell arrive together. That ought to sharpen the senses.
lines.was: The next beginning comes with an ending attached. That changes the feel of everything.

lines.text: {trailer} can put the long view away. There is a final opening to give this story a different destination.
lines.was: {trailer} can put the long view away now. There is a single campaign left to shape.

lines.text: No room left for a vague promise about the future. The future has reached the dugout.
From {loserClub}'s perspective, the chance to change the ending is still alive.
Nothing unfinished can be put aside for a later installment. This is where the postponements end.
lines.was: Nobody can carry an unfinished task into another year after this.

lines.text: With {leader} ahead, the hard part is remembering that close is not the same as finished.
lines.was: With {leader} ahead, the hard part is remembering that being close is not being finished.

lines.text: Earlier disappointments and successes have been brought into the same waiting room. A decision is approaching.
lines.was: Every earlier disappointment or success now leads toward the same immediate question.

lines.text: Ask {trailer} about the opportunity, and there should be very little difficulty finding motivation.
There is something stark about a fresh campaign when you know it comes without a sequel.
Here at {winnerClub}, preparation has acquired the weight of knowing what comes afterward.
Friendly as this rivalry is, you could understand a reluctance to make confident promises down here.
lines.was: A friendly rivalry can still make the thought of getting started feel rather serious.

lines.text: Perhaps {leader} would welcome a comfortable conversation. The contest has other plans.
Some pauses offer relief. This feels more like the breath before the room falls quiet.
Over at {loserClub}, hope still has a very practical place to report for work.
Think of the effort invested getting here. The remaining assignment will give it a conclusion.
lines.was: Think of everything invested getting here. The next season gets to give it a conclusion.

lines.text: If {trailer} wants to leave a different memory, the invitation remains open.
Getting ready is different when a later apology cannot be accompanied by another attempt.
lines.was: Getting ready feels different when there will be no later campaign to make an excuse sound better.

lines.text: {leader} can see the destination, but the remaining stretch has a rival standing in it.
Even the most relaxed friends could find plenty to think about before this gets going.
Take the view from {winnerClub}, no verdict yet, and no comfortable place to hide from the prospect.
{trailer} has the chance every rival wants, a say in how the whole thing ends.
Rehearsals offer the comfort of a mistake you can leave behind. The coming assignment is less forgiving.
lines.was: Rehearsals are a comforting idea. Unfortunately, the coming campaign has no use for that description.

lines.text: Beside the dugout, you could understand {leader} measuring every confident thought against a quiet doubt.
Nobody gets to file this under experience and promise a better reply farther down the road.
So {winnerClub} approaches the point where ambition has to stop leaving its promises undated.
lines.was: So {winnerClub} approaches the point where ambition has to stop talking about someday.

lines.text: Looking beyond the decisive stretch is easy. Working out who gets to smile there is rather harder.
lines.was: Looking beyond the next season is easy. There will be an answer waiting there.

lines.text: What {trailer} does from here can still change which memories hurt, and which are worth revisiting.
lines.was: What {trailer} does from here can still change the meaning of the entire journey.

lines.text: A long rivalry has reached a very short question, who gets to remember this most fondly?
Consider {leader}'s position, able to imagine the satisfaction, unable to claim any of it in advance.
lines.was: Consider {leader}'s position, close enough to imagine the satisfaction, too exposed to enjoy it yet.

lines.text: At this stage, a good night's rest would be a useful part of preparation.
{loserClub} can still choose more than a farewell speech. The outcome remains there to be influenced.
lines.was: {loserClub} can still help choose the closing picture. That should sharpen the appetite.

lines.text: Restlessness is understandable. You can almost hear the question waiting to be answered.
lines.was: Relaxation may have to wait until the ending knows what it wants to be.

lines.text: Should {trailer} sense the weight of the occasion, at least the opportunity weighs just as much.
lines.was: Should {trailer} feel the weight of the occasion, at least the opportunity weighs just as much.

lines.text: The countdown has shed its comfortable distance. Starting again now means accepting that this will be the farewell.
lines.was: The countdown has shed its comfortable distance. Getting started now means getting ready to finish.

lines.text: Around {winnerClub}, tomorrow's ambitions are becoming the immediate assignment.
By now, motivational speeches ought to be unnecessary. The unresolved rivalry is a fairly persuasive speaker.
lines.was: By now, nobody needs a speech about why this matters. The unfinished contest explains itself.

lines.text: Picture {leader} trying to keep the routine ordinary while the stakes feel anything but.
Regrets make awkward baggage for a decisive stretch. There will be time to unpack them afterward.
lines.was: This is an awkward place to carry regrets. Better to leave room for a response.

lines.text: Away at {loserClub}, the window remains open. That is a better invitation than any encouragement from outside.
lines.was: Away at {loserClub}, there is still a future worth preparing for, however narrow the window feels.

lines.text: Rivalries often promise another installment. This particular story is preparing to close the cover.
lines.was: Rivalries usually offer another installment. This particular story is approaching its closing page.

lines.text: Whether {trailer} enjoys the pressure may matter less than finding a way to use it.
Much has been said along the way. Soon, the conversation will have a permanent reference point.
There is reason for {winnerClub} to be restless. Possibility is about to become something settled.
Until the job is done, confidence might want to keep its voice a little lower.
lines.was: Until the remaining business is done, every confident prediction has to leave its shoes by the door.

lines.text: Call it the sternest invitation {leader} has received, finish what this position promises.
Were {leader} hoping for certainty, the remaining business has declined to supply it in advance.
lines.was: {leader} could be forgiven for wanting certainty. The remaining campaign is not offering any in advance.

lines.text: Listen for the missing reassurance, there is always next time. It cannot help with this conclusion.
lines.was: Listen for the missing phrase, there is always next time. It cannot help with this ending.

lines.text: Near {loserClub}'s dugout, the most important thought should be that a chance remains.
Good preparation cannot remove the nerves. It can stop them being the only voice in your ear.
lines.was: Good preparation cannot remove the nerves. It can give them something useful to stand beside.

lines.text: As for {trailer}, this is where the wait becomes a chance to make the response count.
lines.was: As for {trailer}, this is the opportunity to make the wait worthwhile.

lines.text: Distance from the decision has disappeared. Getting back to work means getting ready to live with the answer.
lines.was: The luxury of a distant conclusion has disappeared. Everything left belongs to the immediate task.

lines.text: To {winnerClub}, the impending campaign offers the prospect of a memory that outlasts the contest.
Winning the conversation beforehand will feel fairly hollow if the ending takes another direction.
{leader} must carry expectation into a season that has no interest in granting it favors.
Long-held ambition now has an appointment it cannot postpone.
lines.was: Every ambition now has an appointment it cannot postpone.

lines.text: Imagine {loserClub} turning away from a chance to change this. There is too much still available.
Belief is about to meet its strictest test, carrying on without borrowing reassurance from the future.
lines.was: Faith is about to meet its strictest test, believing without borrowing reassurance from the future.

lines.text: Before {trailer} gets going, a useful reminder, the conclusion has yet to be claimed.
Whatever the confidence beforehand, the decisive season has the right to disagree.
lines.was: Whatever the confidence beforehand, the next campaign has the right to disagree.

lines.text: {winnerClub} has reached the uncomfortable space between hoping for an ending and having to earn it.
Progress can be enjoyed later. The unfinished part needs your attention before the congratulations do.
lines.was: Progress can be enjoyed later. Right now, the unfinished part demands undivided attention.

lines.text: Knowing {trailer} is still involved should keep the celebrations firmly in the imagination.
Tomorrow has run out as a place to leave a promise you have not delivered.
lines.was: Tomorrow is running out as a place to store an unfinished ambition.

lines.text: Put yourself in {leader}'s place, drawn toward the moment, wary of what it might ask.
lines.was: Put yourself in {leader}'s place, wanting the moment without wanting the risk that comes with it.

lines.text: Neither reputation nor reassurance can supply what the closing campaign has still to deliver.
lines.was: Neither reputation nor reassurance can supply what the closing campaign has yet to deliver.

lines.text: By the time {loserClub} is done, this story will have no unanswered ending to lean on.
Ordinary routines become strangely significant with the farewell waiting on the other side.
lines.was: Pressure makes ordinary preparation feel strangely significant when there is no subsequent installment.

lines.text: Look toward {winnerClub}, where the promise of a lasting memory must sit beside the possibility of regret.
Momentum, confidence, expectation, useful company, but no substitutes for delivering when the farewell approaches.
lines.was: Momentum, confidence, expectation, all useful company, but none can do the remaining work for you.

lines.text: Even {trailer} has to stop rehearsing the reply eventually. The opportunity to deliver it is nearly here.
lines.was: Even {trailer} has to stop imagining the response eventually. The chance to make it is nearly here.

lines.text: A last season awaits {leader}, and the lead is about to sit considerably heavier on the shoulders.
lines.was: The last season awaits {leader}, and the lead is about to feel considerably heavier.

lines.text: Familiar routines are useful, but you would understand finding them harder to settle into now.
lines.was: No familiar routine can make the coming assignment feel entirely ordinary.

lines.text: For all the miles covered, {trailer} still has a route into the ending.
Stepping back into action means knowing the conversation afterward could last much longer than the nerves beforehand.
lines.was: Stepping back into this contest means accepting that the conversation afterward could last a long time.

lines.text: {winnerClub} must get ready for the assignment while somehow tuning out the occasion.
lines.was: {winnerClub} has to prepare for the task, while somehow ignoring the scale of the occasion.

lines.text: Ordinary patience becomes surprisingly elusive when the next campaign will settle everything.
A glance toward {loserClub} brings the same reminder, the story is still open for revision.
Somewhere between anticipation and dread sits the peculiar excitement of a decisive season.
Certainty would be pleasant company. Unfortunately, it has not been invited into the dugout.
lines.was: Not yet, {leader}. The satisfaction can wait until there is nothing left for a rival to change.

lines.text: {trailer} has arrived at the point where a hopeful intention must become an actual reply.
lines.was: Certainty would be pleasant company. Unfortunately, it has not been invited into the dugout yet.

lines.text: Quiet routines can seem almost unnatural when the occasion keeps demanding your attention.
lines.was: {trailer} has arrived at the point where a hopeful intention must become the actual reply.

lines.text: Quiet preparation can feel almost unnatural when the occasion keeps demanding your attention.
Awaiting the decision is exhausting. Being responsible for shaping it asks rather more of you.
lines.was: Against {winnerClub}'s ambitions stands the simple fact that the ending remains available to a rival.

lines.text: Waiting for a decision can be exhausting. Being responsible for shaping it is another level entirely.
Nothing settled for {loserClub}, and that is precisely why the preparation matters so much.
Before long, the tense of this rivalry will change from what might happen to what did.
{leader} can leave a permanent answer, provided the thought does not get in the way of the task.
Carry the lessons forward, but leave enough space for the demands that refuse to be settled in advance.
lines.was: Carry every lesson forward, but leave enough space for the demands nobody can settle in advance.

lines.text: Beyond the immediate nerves for {trailer}, there is the possibility of a wonderfully different conclusion.
Closure approaches with all the easy assurances conspicuously absent. You would understand a restless wait.
lines.was: The end of a long contest approaches with all the easy assurances conspicuously absent.

lines.text: Inside {winnerClub}'s thinking, the temptation to imagine afterward has to lose to the work immediately ahead.
Hope is a useful guest at this stage. It cannot be allowed to take over the whole dugout.
lines.was: Hope is a useful guest at this stage. It cannot be allowed to take charge of preparation.

lines.text: Ask how {loserClub} approaches the closing assignment, and there is a simple answer, like it still matters.
lines.was: Ask how {loserClub} should approach this, and there is an uncomplicated answer, like it still matters.

lines.text: Final seasons have a way of making yesterday's arguments feel small beside tomorrow's possibilities.
Still unfinished, still available, {trailer} has a closing opportunity that deserves undivided attention.
lines.was: Still unfinished, still within reach, {trailer} has a chance that deserves every bit of attention.
